The exact sentence “The unexplained transfer of client funds aroused suspicion of fraud among the auditors.” supports two readings: sense 1, if the auditors suspect an unspecified person committed fraud, and sense 3, if they infer that the unexplained transfer itself was fraudulent. The sentence does not name a suspected perpetrator, so it does not resolve whether the suspicion is a person-directed accusation or a tentative proposition.
